faq.title: Questions about the Chair plan
faq.q1: Who is the Chair plan for?
faq.a1: Nail techs, hairdressers and lash artists who rent a chair or desk in a salon and work on their own IČO. Salon employees don't need it: the salon adds them to its account.
faq.q2: Why do I need my own EET?
faq.a2: From 1 January 2027 EET 2.0 applies in Czechia. With your own IČO you are a separate taxpayer, so your sales go out with your own certificate. Ask your accountant about exemptions.
faq.q3: Can the salon owner see my revenue?
faq.a3: No. Receipts, revenue and clients in a Chair account are visible only to you.
faq.q4: How do I pay for the Chair plan?
faq.a4: By card or bank transfer, on the web on the Renew page. No long-term contract. New Chair accounts get 1 month free.
faq.q5: What if I need appointments later?
faq.a5: Switch to Basic at any time. Your data stays.
faq.a6: No. EET 2.0 is included in the Chair plan.
